provenance: Observed failure transcription; early raw draft logs were overwritten during iteration.

attempts.result: fixture wait failed; owned container removed
attempts.cause: Both concurrent writers were required to be blocked directly by the root holder, ignoring a peer already queued ahead. Held requests reached the three-second lock timeout while the incorrect wait ran.
attempts.correction: Observe both real waits without assuming the direct blocker; assert the resulting graph contains only the root holder and peers and reaches the root holder. Keep production lock timeouts unchanged.

acceptedPhases: Draft schema/advisors; 70, 82, 92 draft cases as coverage expanded; independent canonical 92; bounded-source 93; final intended-account-bound canonical 95 in each repo. Final Core runs use each final 95-case response.
